propositions: rebar must support s3:// URLs as ticket-store remotes with SSE-KMS encryption, enabling init/create/claim/push/fetch operations against customer-owned buckets instead of GitHub
when sync.remote is s3:// and git-remote-s3 helper is missing or below minimum version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the required pip install

concurrent or legacy S3 pushes can create multiple bundle files per ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at multiple SHAs and breaking fresh clones; this state must self-heal non-interactively by merge without data loss
the optional [s3] dependency (git-remote-s3>=0.3.2) must be declared, version-checked via a guard function, and wired into push and init paths to enforce the helper availability gate
documentation must cover optional S3 dependency, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket setup, IAM configuration, and sync.remote=s3:// usage
